notes: Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Primary drive: reduce per-token cost and improve tail latency for user-facing chat while keeping parity with current provider (they run on OpenAI + custom caching today). Team is engineering heavy (two senior ML infra engineers, PM for AI features). Evaluation path: Hosted API POC -> run parity/regression harness -> move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower unit cost if parity acceptable. POC details: ingest ~50k conversation turns and 2M embedding vectors for search; target latency <=150ms median for short chats, p95 under 500ms for interactive flows; throughput goal: sustained 30–50 qps for peak windows. Key migration concerns: prompt parity (format differences: OpenAI chat-completions vs Redwood's streaming/compat endpoint), tokenization differences impacting cost estimates, stop-token and function-calling edge cases, reranking score calibration. Recent eval: Redwood hosted matched quality on ~90% of prompts but 12 prompts showed regression (repetition/hallucination) — SE suggested prompt tweaks and quantization-profile adjustments. Security team needs SOC2 report and SSO test account before Dedicated contract. Sales ask: provide a mapping table of equivalent pricing tiers (OpenAI vs Redwood hosted) and a short SOW for a 3-month Dedicated trial with rollback to hosted if regressions persist. Quote from PM: "If we can't reach prompt parity without heavy prompt engineering, it's a non-starter — must be plug-and-play for top 80% of traffic."
